d:
Shoulder-length ash blonde hair with a sharp side parting and sleek texture. Sharp, narrowed almond-shaped eyes of a cold steel grey shade. Apparent age of mid-twenties with a refined, arrogant maturity. A slender, athletic build wearing a high-collared midnight black frock coat over a crimson silk waistcoat and white cravat.
SIGNATURE DETAILS: a gold-topped walking cane and a polished black top hat.
